declaration.hidden_update_rule: Each cell carries a one-bit refractory/age flag indicating whether a currently visible live cell was just born this step or survived from the previous step; newborn live cells can survive one more step while older live cells die, and dead cells clear the flag.
declaration.mechanism: Births follow Conway Life's Moore-neighborhood rule B3. Visible dynamics are therefore close to Life, but with live cells lasting at most two steps: a dead cell with exactly three live neighbors becomes alive, a live cell survives only if it is in its first visible step and has exactly two or three neighbors, and any older live cell dies regardless.
